name: How long does a typical luxury home design-build project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical luxury home design-build project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a luxury home design-build project is highly variable, influenced by factors such as the scope of work, design complexity, material lead times, and permitting processes. While a smaller renovation might take 6-12 months, a new custom luxury home could range from 12-24 months or more from initial concept to completion. Opus Builders provides a detailed project schedule at the outset, with regular updates to keep you informed. Our integrated approach often helps to mitigate delays compared to traditional construction models.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary greatly based on scope and complexity. New luxury homes can take 12-24 months, while renovations are typically 6-12 months.
